button.$description: Button. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens. Everything lives under the `component.*` namespace: the shadcn bridge already publishes leaves named `input`, `card`, `radius` and so on, and a token path cannot be both a leaf and a group.

corner-xs.$description: Corners for the xs sizes, capped so a 24px control never reads as over-rounded.

corner-sm.$description: Corners for the sm sizes, capped a little looser than xs.

background-active.$description: The pressed tone. A button rendered as an anchor uses the same hover and press as a native button — one interaction language, whatever the element.

outline.$description: The outline variant — the neutral partner to a primary in dialog footers, forms and toolbars. Its fill differs by theme (transparent on light, the quiet control wash on dark, matching every dark field), so `background` lives in the theme overlays; the edge is the same decorative strong border in both themes.
